brief:
An Israeli drone strike killed two Palestinians and wounded several others, including one critically, near the headquarters of the UN agency for Palestinian refugees in Gaza City on Wednesday, Middle East Eye reported.

The strike occurred in an area housing the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees (UNRWA) compound, a major humanitarian presence in the densely populated territory.

title: Israeli drone strike kills two Palestinians in Gaza City
